strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Well, well, looks like they've finally shown up.
Good, the enemy hasn't reached Solomon yet!
What a laid-back bunch. Looks like we can secure Solomon first.
No, we still have to deal with that many enemies...
Even with the terrain on our side... it'll be a tough fight.
Let's put the tough robots up front, like Mazinger and Grendizer,
and close in all at once!
That's actually sensible, for you, Koji.
Once in a blue moon, anyway.
Great Mazinger, Grendizer, plus Dancougar and Dangaioh...
We've got plenty of heavily armored robots now.
So we push through in one go and take Solomon.
Fancy words, but it's still just brute force.
Our forces may be coming together, but they're still not enough...
We'll just have to adapt as we go.
Nothing ever goes smoothly, huh.
Well, no use grumbling about it!
The Aestivalis team will use their mobility to throw the enemy off.
Everyone, prepare to launch.
Captain, you actually sound like a captain for once...
Believe it or not, she was a top student at Federation University.
Maybe she decided this is the moment that counts.
Indeed. If we secure Solomon, just think how much
we'll save on supply costs from here on...
The enemy won't wait for us, y'know? Shouldn't we sortie?
Let's just get moving.
Captain Bajeena...?
Something's off.
The big mobile armor I understand, but with that many agile MS,
why not take Solomon and its terrain advantage?
You mean... it's a lure?
...You may be right.
But we can't just sit and watch, and we can't fall back either...
All units, launch!
Huh? Where are the ones always first to yell "Let's launch already"...
the Cyber Beast Force?
...They've already gone to the deck.
That was fast!
The whole cast is assembling.
Now... we just wait for our Guests to make their entrance. Heh heh...
Lotta them around. There's mobile suits I've never seen, too.
There are Titans mobile suits too...
They're said to date from the Gryps Conflict, when that sharp operator
from the Jupiter resource fleet was making trouble.
You're well informed, Shiba. They're high-performance MS. Stay alert.
Shoot 'em down and they're all the same. Just scrap metal.
Still... their units aren't standardized at all...?
You mean... they're a ragtag bunch?
Lieutenant, take a look around you.
...Huh?
Yeah, yeah, Londo Bell's units aren't standardized at all either.
You idiots! Londo Bell isn't some military unit!
It's a super robot legion! Can you believe this POWER!?
Being a corps, we've got robots galore... right to the core... Heh heh...
What are you doing!? Commence attack!
Quite a lively bunch, aren't they? But... it's about to get noisier...
The venue, Solomon, is open. Care to go first? ...Heh heh heh heh.
I see... The Earthlings' robots are swarming here.
There's no doubt this is the point from the intel.
Hm! That's King Vega's Royal Guard...!
That is indeed the Earth army Duke Fleed is aiding!
Heh heh... They've bested us so far, but not this time...!
Our Guests have all arrived... Heh heh. Now, let the show begin.
Brother! What do we do!?
Why's the timing always so lousy? ...Well, I guess that's nothing new.
True, but we've got no choice...
The timing's too convenient... Doesn't something seem off?
Zeon is... awfully calm. Something's definitely wrong...
It seems they've decided to watch from the sidelines
while we and the Vega Star Federation fight...
Zeon's so relaxed...
because they knew the Vega Star Federation was coming...!
Captain Bright, so we're on our own here?
Right, we'll handle this ourselves. Take them out one by one!
This sucks. I wanna beat the Gaizok, but we keep taking detours.
The Vega Star Federation are invaders too, Kappei.
You lot, don't lay a finger on the aliens! We'll take 'em all at once.
First we crush the ones Duke Fleed is with!
Leave the colony army for later!
Seems both the aliens and the colony-born have it in for us.
Unbelievable.
No doubt. But this is no time to whine about it. ...Let's do this!
Solomon...
Right on time...
Now, make it a showy one, Nightmare of Solomon. Heh heh.
What!? Is that...!?
A Gundam!? That's... Prototype Unit 2!
Gundam Prototype Unit 2...? Hey, you don't mean...!
After reports that it was stolen on Earth... it was never seen again!
What's that MS doing here!?
Hm, what's this? At a glance, it looks like
the robots of Duke Fleed's allies, doesn't it?
I knew it...! Zeon never meant to capture Solomon...!
Captain! Tell everyone to brace for the flash!
What's the big deal, just 'cause a bulky Gundam showed up, Quattro?
Brace for the flash...? What do you mean?
Huh? Is it gonna do something?
Is it gonna use a blinding attack?
Captain! Does that thing really have...!?
There's no other reason for it to show up here...!
The Mk-82 laser fusion warhead, if I remember...!
What the heck's that?
Shall I explain? Simply put... it's a nuclear bomb.
It's a nuclear attack... banned long ago by the Antarctic Treaty!
Wait, nuclear... What!?
Seriously!?
Solomon... I have returned!
Everyone! Are you all right!?
...Ngh... That was insane...
Ugh, my eyes are still seeing spots...
What power... Solomon...!?
How reckless...!
So they never meant to use Solomon as a base in the first place...!
That was a shock. Looks like they meant to take out the Vegans too.
But... that means we've lost a supply base...!
So this was their aim...!
Good work, Major Gato. Now, let's clean up the rest!
Tch, an all-out battle right after a huge blast! What a mess.
Koji, this is no time to be so carefree!
Should I call it luck that the enemy's fewer now...? Damn it!
Tetsuya! Here they come!
Anavel Gato... That boy from back then has come so far... Impressive...!
...Strange... Shouldn't it be about time!?
You've done as you please long enough...!
The enemy's moves are in disarray? What are they panicking about?
What's going on? And it's strange how they haven't moved at all...
Maybe they had some kind of plan...
Looks like their plan fell through. Let's finish them off!
When they're all deflated like this, it's time to strike.
If you've got time to dither,
shouldn't you just attack already?
All right, let's go, everyone!
(That's right... I've gotta end this fight fast!)
So let's push through, Captain.
Right, we'll use Solomon as our base and strike the enemy!
We've got this in the bag. Let's go!
Things are going our way, Tetsuya.
What a noisy bunch. Can't they shut up and fight?
...What!? Gundam Unit 2!? Tch, how infuriating.
Hm!? Hey, that red one's running away!?
Who'd have thought the damage from Earth would hurt this much...!
We'll be withdrawing here!
It got away!
Huh? Looked like it could still fight. Quick to run, that one.
...A well-timed withdrawal. Captain, shall we pursue?
No, let it go, Lieutenant. Mop up the remaining enemies.
Tch, time to go...! The objective is achieved.
A pity I couldn't finish off Londo Bell all at once...
It's not that easy, it seems.
Running away!? I won't let you keep misusing the Gundam!
The Gundam, you say...? Absurd! Mobile suits are mere tools of war!
Sentimentality on the battlefield is foolish!
What!?
Uraki! Don't pursue too far!
We lost this fight the moment that nuke hit Solomon...!
Just focus on getting out of here!
Ngh...!
What!? ...A Gundam...? This Gundam is...!
Geez, another bulky one showed up.
Hey, hey, how many types of Gundam are there?
Oh, plenty. ...Mountains of them.
If you stand in our way...!
...Reinforcements!?
What!? A Gundam as big as Prototype Unit 2!?
Wait! This feeling, and that Gundam...!
That's right! Judau!
What, you know him?
Heh, sorry I'm late, but Judau Ashta
and the Double Zeta have arrived!
Judau! Is it really you!?
Why would I lie? I'm back from Jupiter, Bright!
Good, we can't let them ravage Solomon any further!
Join the line right away!
That Gundam is...?
A lady from Anaheim named Nina had it taken apart for tuning,
so she put it together and sent it over. Pretty reckless gal, huh?
Are mechanics weirdos everywhere, or what?
Sorry, Judau. I'd hoped not to drag you into the fighting...
Don't sweat it, Quattro! I couldn't just sit still, right?
Geez, an ally's fine and all, but another brat!?
Big talk from the most childish one here.
What'd you say? Masato, you...!
...He's hopeless.
What a kid.
Good... Looks like every enemy in this area's been dealt with.
What!? ...A Gundam...? This Gundam is...!
Geez, another bulky one showed up.
Hey, hey, how many types of Gundam are there?
Oh, plenty. ...Mountains of them.
If you stand in our way...!
Wait! This feeling, and that Gundam...!
That's right! Judau!
What, you know him?
Heh, sorry I'm late, but Judau Ashta

A lady from Anaheim named Nina had it taken apart for tuning,

Are mechanics weirdos everywhere, or what?
Sorry, Judau. I'd hoped not to drag you into the fighting...
Don't sweat it, Quattro! I couldn't just sit still, right?
Geez, an ally's fine and all, but another brat!?
Big talk from the most childish one here.
What'd you say? Masato, you...!
...He's hopeless.
What a kid.
Judau, you're so late!
What were you doing while we were surrounded by aliens!?
Shut up, I told you I was waiting on assembly, didn't I?
Now, now, go easy on him, Roux.
Judau, this is the state of the Earth Sphere.
Jaburo's held by an unknown enemy, and we're about all that can act.
You don't have to spell it out, Bright. Leave it to me.
...Allies are welcome, but... that one was rough too.
Just holding on is a win, right, Lieutenant Emma?
Exactly, we have to cherish what went right!
Is this any time for humans to be shooting at each other? Damn Zeon!
In effect, the Federation has no real strength as an organization now...
I can see why they'd use this chaos to get rid of us first.
I get that, but... then what are we fighting for...
Is fighting... the only way...?
Captain, the Gandor team's assault on Jaburo should be soon...
...Right! All units, return to ship!
